references.role: Painting, lighting, full-body framing and charcoal backdrop ONLY; do not copy this person's face, clothing, anatomy or equipment

gmReview.notes: Fail. Regenerate. Pick some mediium-sized piece of equipment it's masquerading as.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a single full-body portrait for a fictional tabletop game's Bestiary. Naturalistic HAND-PAINTED illustration, matching the supplied painting reference's grounded proportions, restrained brushwork and empty dark charcoal subtly painted backdrop. Soft neutral upper-left illumination, muted earthy palette, a small diffuse contact shadow only. Broad, calm light-to-shadow gradients on large surfaces; detail is selective at the face, silhouette and a few functional seams. Large folds and local damage rather than a uniform cracked-paint mesh or high-frequency surface noise. Entire subject, every foot, appendage, tool tip and tail comfortably inside a vertical 4:5 portrait with about 6% breathing room. No scenery, captions, letters, logos, frame, base disc or circular crop. A neutral standing/display pose, no combat scene, target, victim, blood or gore. Any style-only human reference supplies painting and lighting ONLY, never its person, clothes, weapons or anatomy.
Create a fresh MEDIUM TECHMORWA masquerading as an ordinary old FRONT-LOADING WASHING MACHINE, not the rejected exposed beetle design. One waist-high, squat rectangular faded cream/off-white washing-machine body with a large circular front loading door and a simple row of blank physical controls above. It is an ORGANIC MIMIC whose outer shell convincingly imitates the smooth enamel appliance panels; only a few subtle soft irregularities at seams reveal it is alive. The round front door is ajar, revealing a dark organic hollow in place of a metal drum. FOUR thick dark flexible organic tentacles emerge from that opening: two spread low to brace on the ground, two curl loosely forward to reveal its true nature. No human, prey, injury, blood, raw flesh, exposed organs or excessive teeth. Keep enough complete machine shell visible that it reads instantly as a washing machine, rather than an insect carrying an appliance. Broad quiet enamel planes, restrained local discoloration along the bottom and a few panel seams; no carpet of tiny rust pits or fractal cracks. Three-quarter-front full-subject view, all four tentacle tips and the door safely inside the frame. Empty shared charcoal backdrop, no laundry room, sewer, debris or actual manufacturer logo/text.
